name: bolder-os
description: BOLDER OS — private internal operating system for BOLDER Marketing. Phase 1: Project Manager terminal.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server start
